NetworkAttester.ChargeDifftestMain.why: 4,000 random instances on which advice v1's charge (AdviceV1.window from a carry, and AdviceV1.charges from the book's priors) gives what arith_encode.reference_charge gives, window by window and chained

NetworkAttester.DifftestMain.why: 10,000 random instances on which NetTiming's definitions (expectedRow, and Accepted of constantRate and StatusComplete by decide) give what the Python audit gives: schedule.expected_grids, Audit.check_link with the first differing bucket, Audit.check_ingress_link, and each prefix's acceptance

NetworkAttester.WindowDifftestMain.why: 4,000 instances, random but for the charge's edge at 2^CW, on which advice v1's whole window charged with its length terms (WindowCharge.window from a carry, and WindowCharge.charges from the book's first carry) gives what window_charge.reference_window gives, window by window and chained
